description.zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。
description.en: The page number of the current page in a paged query.

description.zh: 指定要查询的资产对外暴露的公网IP。
description.en: The public IP address that is exposed on the Internet for the asset to query.

description.zh: 指定要查询的资产实例ID。
description.en: The instance ID of the asset to query.

description.zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
> 建议PageSize取值不要为空。
description.en:
The maximum number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned per page.
> Set PageSize to a non-empty value.

description.zh:
资源目录成员账号主账号ID。
>调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数。
description.en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member accounts in the resource folder.
> Invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

description.zh:
指定要查看的统计值类型。取值：
- **exposureType**：暴露在互联网中的网关资产。
- **exposurePort**：暴露在互联网中的端口。
- **exposureComponent**：暴露在互联网中的系统组件。
- **exposureIp**：暴露在互联网中的IP地址。
description.en:
The type of statistics to query. Valid values:
- **exposureType**: gateway assets exposed on the Internet.
- **exposurePort**: ports exposed on the Internet.
- **exposureComponent**: system components exposed on the Internet.
- **exposureIp**: IP addresses exposed on the Internet.

description.zh:
**StatisticsType**为**exposureType**时，指定要查询的网关资产类型。取值：
- **SLB**：负载均衡SLB公网IP。
- **DNAT**：使用DNAT功能连接互联网的NAT网关。
description.en:
The Asset Type of the gateway to query. This parameter takes effect only when **StatisticsType** is set to **exposureType**. Valid values:
- **SLB**: public IP address of a load balancing SLB instance.
- **DNAT**: NAT gateway that uses the DNAT feature to connect to the Internet.

description.zh: **StatisticsType**为**exposureType**时，指定要查询的网关实例ID。
description.en: The instance ID of the gateway to query. This parameter takes effect only when **StatisticsType** is set to **exposureType**.
The UUID of the server to query.

title.zh: 暴露资产统计数据的详情
